Mheshimiwa Mtolea unajua ukisema utaratibu wakati niliyetoka kuongea ni mimi nadhani unaijua Kanuni inayohusu utaratibu maana yake ni kwamba nimefanya kinyume na Kanuni. Ukitumia Kanuni ya Kuhusu Utaratibu maana yake nimefanya kinyume na Kanuni ndiyo zinavyosema hizi Kanuni zetu. Kwa hiyo, naomba uzisome vizuri utumie Kanuni nyingine.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, sasa namuita Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Nchi, Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu, Sera, Bunge, Vijana, Kazi, Ajira na Watu Wenye Ulemavu atoe hoja ya kutengua Kanuni za Bunge.
HOJA YA KUTENGUA KANUNI
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushukuru.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba niwasilishe mbele ya Kiti chako maelezo ya Hoja ya Kutengua Kanuni za Bunge.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Mkutano wa Sita wa Bunge unaoanza leo tarehe 31 Januari, 2017 ambao umepangwa kumalizika tarehe 10 Februari, 2017. Katika Mkutano huo, pamoja na mambo mengine, Bunge linatarajia kujadili na kupitisha Miswada mitatu ya Sheria ya Serikali pamoja na kupokea, kujadili na kupitisha taarifa za mwaka za Kamati 14 za Kudumu za Bunge.

KWA KUWA Kamati ya Uongozi katika kikao chake kilichofanyika siku ya Jumatatu tarehe 30 Januari, 2017, iliona kwamba siku zilizopo ni chache na taratibu zikiendelea kama kawaida upo uwezekano wa shughuli zilizopangwa kutofanyika kwa ufanisi na hivyo iliazimia kuliomba Bunge likubali kutengua baadhi ya Kanuni zake ili upatikane muda zaidi wa shughuli zilizopangwa.

NA KWA KUWA, kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 21(2) na (4), vikao vya Bunge huanza saa 3.00 asubuhi hadi saa 7.00 mchana na kurejea saa 11.00 jioni hadi saa 1.45 usiku; na kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 28(15), Bunge haliwezi kukutana siku za Jumamosi, Jumapili au siku za mapumziko; na kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 62(1) kifungu cha (a), Mbunge anayechangia hoja atachangia kwa muda wa dakika zisizozidi 15.

HIVYO BASI, Bunge linaazima kwamba katika Mkutano huu wa Sita, Kanuni za 28 na 62 zitenguliwe kwa mujibu wa Kauni ya 28(3) na 153(1) ili kubadili muda wa vikao vya Bunge, muda wa Mbunge kuchangia hoja Bungeni na siku za vikao vya Bunge kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, namba moja, Kanuni ya 28(4) na (5) zitenguliwe ili Bunge likisitishwa saa 7.00 mchana lirejee tena saa 10.00 jioni badala ya saa 11.00 jioni. Vile vile Kanuni ya 28(15) itenguliwe ili Bunge likutane siku ya Jumamosi tarehe 4 Februari, 2017 kuanzia saa 3.00 asubuhi hadi saa 8.00 mchana, isipokuwa kwamba katika kikao cha siku hiyo ya Jumamosi hakutakuwa na kipindi cha maswali.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, vile vile Kanuni ya 62(1)(a) itenguliwe ili kila Mbunge achangie hoja kwa muda wa dakika zisizozidi 10 badala ya dakika 15. Utaratibu huu mpya uanze kutumika Ijumaa tarehe 3 Februari, 2017, Bunge litakapoanza shughuli za kupokea na kujadili taarifa za Kamati za Kudumu za Bunge na uendelee hadi kukamilika kwa Mkutano wa Sita.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba kutoa hoja.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naafiki.
Katibu.
Kauli za Mawaziri.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, tunazo Kauli za Mawaziri, tutaanza na Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi.
KAULI ZA MAWAZIRI
Hali ya Chakula Nchini
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za Kudumu za Bunge toleo la Januari, 2016 Kanuni 49, naomba kutoa Kauli ya Serikali kuhusu hali ya Chakula na Lishe kwa mwaka 2016/2017.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, utakumbuka katika Bunge lako la Kumi, Serikali ilitoa kauli kuhusu upatikanaji wa mahitaji ya chakula baada ya kukamilisha tathmini ya awali ya uzalishaji wa mazao ya chakula kwa mwaka 2015/2016 na upatikanaji wa chakula mwaka 2016/2017. Katika Kauli hiyo ya Serikali, Bunge

lako lilielezwa kuwa tathmini ilionesha kuwa Kitaifa, uzalishaji wa chakula utafikia tani 16,172,841 za chakula na mahitaji ya chakula kwa mwaka 2016/2017 ni wastani wa tani milioni 13,159,326 na hivyo nchi itakuwa na ziada ya chakula tani milioni 4,013,515.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kati ya ziada hiyo, tani milioni 1,101,341 ni za mazao ya nafaka na tani 1,912,174 ni za mazao yasiyo ya nafaka. Nchi ilikuwa na kiwango cha utoshelevu cha asilimia 123. Aidha, pamoja na hali nzuri ya chakula kitaifa, kulikuwa na Halmashauri 43 ambazo zilikuwa na maeneo yenye upungufu wa chakula.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mwezi Januari mwaka huu, Serikali kwa kushirikiana na wadau wengine wa masuala ya usalama wa chakula na lishe, imekamilisha tathmini ya kina ya hali ya chakula na lishe nchini zikiwemo Halmashauri 43 zilizoainishwa mwanzo kuwa na upungufu wa chakula. Tathmini hii ilishirikisha Shirika la Umoja na Mataifa la Kilimo na Chakula (FAO) na Mpango wa Chakula Duniani (World Food Program – WFP).

Aidha, wataalam kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Kilimo cha Sokoine (SUA) na Chuo Kikuu cha Dodoma (UDOM) na Wizara ya Afya, kupitia taasisi yake ya chakula na lishe, TFNC walishiriki. Tathmini hii imebainisha kuwa kuna Halmashauri 55 zenye upungufu wa chakula.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, lengo kuu la tathmini lilikuwa ni kuainisha mwenendo wa uzalishaji wa mazao ya chakula na masuala yanayohusiana na lishe katika msimu wa 2015/2016 na athari zake katika mfumo ya maisha ya wananchi katika maeneo husika kwa kipindi cha Januari, 2017 na matarajio katika kipindi cha Mei, 2017 kabla ya mavuno ya msimu wa 2016/2017. Matokeo ya tathmini ya kina yameiwezesha Serikali kuchukua maamuzi stahii katika utekelezaji wa jukumu la hali endelevu ya usalama wa chakula na lishe nchini.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tathmini hii ilizingatia Mihimili Minne ya usalama wa chakula ambayo ni upatikanaji wa chakula (food availability), ufikiwaji wa chakula (food accessibility) utumiaji wa chakula (food utilization) na uthabiti wa chakula (food stability).

Aidha, ilitumia mfumo wa uainishaji wa madaraja mbalimbali ya usalama wa chakula na lishe, Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) unaotumika Kimataifa katika kuainisha watu na hali mbalimbali za makundi, phases kiusalama wa chakula na lishe na aina ya hatua stahiki za kukabiliana nazo. Mfumo huu umewezesha kuchanganua vigezo mbalimbali na kutoa
taswira ya hali halisi ilivyo kuanzia Julai, 2016 hadi Julai, 2017 na hali inayotarajiwa katika kipindi kijacho kuanzia mwezi Februari hadi mwezi Mei mwaka huu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, taarifa ya hali ya upatikanaji wa mvua kutoka mikoa inayopata mvua za vuli, zinaonesha kwa ujumla mvua zimechelewa kuanza na zimenyesha katika kiwango cha wastani na chini ya wastani, zikiwa na mtawanyiko usioridhisha. Mikoa ya Kagera, Mwanza, Geita, Mara, Pwani, Tanga, Morogoro pamoja na sehemu ya Mkoa wa Shinyanga na Simiyu, mvua zilipoanza kunyesha zilikuwa chini ya wastani. Ukosefu wa mvua za vuli uliipata pia Mikoa ya Kilimanjaro, Arusha na Manyara. Mazao yanayopandwa katika baadhi ya maeneo hayo yameathirika kutokana na ukame uliojitokeza ukiwamo Mkoa wa Kagera katika Wilaya za Kyerwa, Misenyi na Karagwe.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kipindi cha mvua za msimu kilichoanza mwezi Novemba mwaka 2016 kwa maeneo yanayopata msimu mmoja wa mvua (unimodal); Mikoa ya Kigoma, Tabora, Katavi, Singida, Dodoma, Rukwa, Songwe, Mbeya, Iringa, Njombe, Ruvuma, Lindi na Mtwara, zinatarajiwa kuendelea hadi mwezi Aprili, Mwaka huu 2017. Kwa ujumla mvua hizi zinatarajiwa kuwa za wastani katika maeneo mengi, isipokuwa maeneo ya Kaskazini mwa Mkoa wa Lindi yanatarajiwa kupata mvua chini ya wastani katika kipindi cha mwezi Januari hadi Februari, 2017.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali imekuwa na inaendelea kufuatilia mwenendo wa bei za mazao ya chakula hususan mahindi, mchele na maharage ili kujiridhisha uwepo na upatikanaji wake sokoni. Bei ya wastani ya mahindi katika msimu wa chakula na soko kwa mwaka 2016/2017 imekuwa na mwelekeo wa kupanda kuanzia mwanzo wa mwezi Julai, 2016. Bei hii iko juu ukilinganisha na bei katika kipindi kama hicho mwaka 2015. Hadi tarehe 23 Januari 2017 bei ya mahindi kwa gunia la kilo 100 imepanda na kufikia wastani wa Kitaifa; naomba hapa nirudie, „wastani wa Kitaifa” wa shilingi 92,057 ukilinganishwa na mwezi Januari, 2016 ambapo gunia la kilo 100 liliuzwa kwa wastani wa shilingi 67,048. Kwa upande wa mchele, bei zina mwelekeo mzuri bado kwa ulinganisho wa mwaka jana na bado hazijabadilika sana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kupanda na kushuka kwa bei katika kipindi kama hiki ni jambo lililotegemewa, kwani mwanzo mwa msimu hakuna mazao yanayoingia sokoni na hivyo hupelekea bei kupanda. Aidha, mwanzo wa mavuno, bei hushuka kutokana na mazao mengi kuingia sokoni. Hali ya mwenendo usioridhisha wa unyeshaji wa mvua za vuli na za msimu kwa kipindi cha 2016/2017 kwa ajili ya upatikanaji wa chakula kwa mwaka 2017/2018 katika

maeneo mengi ya nchi, imechangia wafanyabiashara wa nafaka nchini na hasa zao la mahindi kuingiza zao hili kidogo kidogo sokoni, hivyo kuongeza kasi ya uhitaji kutoka kwa wananchi na kusababisha bei kuzidi kupanda.
Aidha, uwepo wa mahitaji makubwa na bei nzuri ya mahindi katika nchi jirani zinazotuzunguka ambazo zilikuwa na upungufu wa chakula, umesababisha bei ya mahindi kuzidi kupanda.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tathmini ya kina ya hali ya chakula na lishe imekamilishwa. Matokeo ya tathmini hii yamebainisha kuwa hali ya upatikanaji wa chakula bado ni ya kuridhisha pamoja na kuwa maeneo yenye upungufu wa chakula hapa nchini yapo.

Mheshimiaw Naibu Spika, tathmini imebainisha kuwa jumla ya tani 35,491 za chakula zinahitajika ili kukabiliana na hali ya upungufu wa chakula na lishe kati ya mwezi Februari na mwezi Aprili mwaka huu kwa watu 1,186,028 walioainishwa kuwa wana upungufu wa chakula katika Halmashauri 55 tulizozitaja.

Aidha, jumla ya watu 1,018,603 wasio na uwezo wa kupata chakula (destitute population) watahitaji tani 3,549 za chakula cha bei nafuu haraka. Serikali imekwishaanza kuchukua hatua kukabiliana na hali hiyo ikiwemo ya kuuza chakula kwa bei nafuu katika maeneo yaliyobainishwa kuwa na upungufu mkubwa ili kushusha bei iliyopo na hatimaye kuwawezesha wananchi wa kipato cha chini kumudu bei.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kutokana na kuchelewa kwa mvua na mtawanyiko usioridhisha katika maeneo mengi hapa nchini, athari zifuatazo zinatarajiwa kutokea.
(1) Matarajio ya malengo ya uzalishaji wa mazao ya chakula huenda yasifikiwe.
(2) Uzalishaji wa mbegu za mazao ya kilimo utapungua.
(3) Uwezekano wa kuongezeka kwa bei za baadhi ya chakula, upo.
(4) Kupungua kwa mapato yatokanayo na ushuru wa mazao kwa baadhi ya Halmashauri.
(5) Uwezekano wa kuwa na maeneo mengi yenye upungufu wa chakula na hivyo kuongezeka kwa kiwango cha utapiamlo.
(6) Kuongezeka kwa migogoro kati ya wakulima na wafugaji kutokana na uhaba wa malisho na maji.
(7) Uwezekano wa kupungua kwa mapato yatokanayo na mazao ya kilimo yanayouzwa nje ya nchi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ili kukabiliana na athari za ukame kama nilivyozieleza hapo juu, tathmini imebainisha kuwa Halmashauri za Wilaya hizi 55 zinahitaji jumla ya tani 1,969 za mbegu bora za mahindi, mtama na mizizi inayokamaa kwa muda mfupi na kustahimili ukame.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mbegu hizo zinahitajika ziwafikie mwezi Februari mwaka huu ili ziweze kupandwa katika msimu wa 2016/2017 katika maeneo yanayoendelea kupata mvua wakati huu wa mwaka.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali sasa inachukua hatua za makusudi kuhakikisha kuwa hali ya chakula na lishe ni imara na hatua hizi ni pamoja na hizi zifuatazo:-

(1) Kusimamia usambazi wa mbegu za mazao ya kilimo zinazostahimili ukame na zinazozaa kwa muda mfupi ambazo ni pamoja na mtama, uwele na mbegu za mazao aina ya mizizi na mihogo na viazi vitamu ili kuzitumia vizuri mvua zinazonyesha kwa sasa. Wizara ilikutana na wazalishaji wa mbegu za mazao ya kilimo Jijini Arusha mwaka 2016 mwezi Oktoba ili kubaini mahitaji ya mbegu ikiwa ni pamoja na usambazaji wa mbegu hizio ili ziweze kuwafikia wakulima kwa wakati.

(2) Kuhamasisha wakulima kupanda mazao aina ya mizizi, mtama na uwele kwa maeneo yanayopata mvua za masika ambazo zinaendelea kunyesha na mawakala wa pembejeo pamoja na vituo vya utafiti vilivyopo katika kanda mbalimbali hapa nchini.
(3) Serikali kupitia Wakala wa Hifadhi ya Chakula (NRFA), itaendelea kuhifadhi kwa uangalifu chakula kilichopo ili kitumike pale kitakapohitajika.
(4) Kuhamasisha sekta binafsi kununua mazao ya chakula katika maeneo yaliyo na ziada na kuyauza katika maeneo yenye uhaba wa chakula. Aidha, wafanyabiashara waliohifadhi mahindi; narudia. „Aidha
wafanyabiashara waliohifadhi mahindi” wanaomba kusambaza chakula hicho katika masoko ya ndani ya nchi, jambo ambalo litasaidia kupunguza mfumuko wa bei.
(5) Kuhimiza usindikaji wa mazao ya chakula kwa kuyaongezea thamani na kuwaelimisha wananchi kuhusu umuhimu wa kula vyakula vya aina zote.

(6) Kutokana na hali ya mwenendo wa unyeshaji wa mvua za vuli na msimu kutoridhisha katika meneo mengi ya nchi, Wakuu wa Mikoa na Wakuu wa Wilaya wanaelekezwa kuendelea kuhamasisha na kusimamia wakulima kutumia mbegu zinazokomaa mapema na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame.
(7) Kuwashauri wananchi kutumia kwa uangalifu, kutunza na kuhifadhi akiba ya chakula kwa matumizi ya kaya.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, baada ya kusema hayo, napenda kusisitiza kuwa Serikali itaendelea kufuatilia hali ya chakula na lishe nchini kwa kushirikiana na wadau wetu ili kuhakikisha kuwa hali ya chakula na lishe ni imara wakati wote. Aidha, wakulima waendelee kuzitumia mvua zinazoendelea kunyesha kwa kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kukomaa kwa muda mfupi na pia waendelee kutunza na kutumia chakula walichonacho kwa uangalifu.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushukuru wewe na Waheshimiwa Wabunge kwa kunisikiliza na naomba kuwasilisha.
Ahsante Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi.
Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Fedha na Mipango, Mheshimiwa Dkt. Phillip Mpango.
HALI YA UCHUMI WA TAIFA

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya Bunge namba 49(1) ya Kanuni za Bunge Toleo la Januari, 2016 naomba kuwasilisha Kauli ya Serikali kuhusu Hali ya Uchumi wa Taifa, hususan mwenendo wa viashiria mbalimbali vya uchumi, ikiwemo ukuaji wa uchumi, mfumuko wa bei, mwenendo wa sekta ya nje na akiba ya fedha za kigeni,
mwenendo wa Sekta ya Fedha ikiwa ni pamoja na hali ya ukwasi, lakini pia deni la Taifa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali inatoa kauli hii ili kukitaarifu chombo hiki muhimu cha wawakilishi wa wananchi kuhusu afya ya uchumi wa Taifa letu ili Waheshimiwa Wabunge waweze kuwafikishia wananchi ujumbe na maelezo sahihi badala ya uvumi wa mitaani.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza ukuaji wa pato la Taifa. Ukuaji wa uchumi ni mojawapo ya viashiria vinavyotazamwa katika kutathmini afya uchumi wa Taifa. Takwimu za ukuaji wa pato la Taifa, zinaonesha kuwa uchumi wa Taifa umeendelea kukua na Tanzania ni miongoni mwa nchi za Bara la Afrika Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara ambazo uchumi wake unakuwa kwa kasi kubwa zaidi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kama mifano tu, Kenya ukuaji wa uchumi mwaka 2015 ilikuwa asilimia 5.6 na inatarajiwa kwa mwaka 2016 uchumi wa Kenya utakua kwa 6%. Kwa upande wa Rwanda mwaka 2015 uchumi wao ulikua kwa 6.9% na mwaka 2016 utakua kwa 6%. Kadhalika Uganda, 2015 uchumi wao ulikua kwa 4.8% na mwaka 2016 4.9%. Kwa upande wa Zambia, 2015 uchumi wao ulikua kwa 3% na mwaka 2016 inakadiriwa utakua kwa hiyo hiyo 3%.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, wastani wa ukuaji wa uchumi kwa nchi za Kusini mwa Jangwa la Sahara mwaka 2015 ilikuwa 3.4% na mwaka 2016 ni asilimia 1.4%. Kwa Upnde wa nchi yetu, mwaka 2015 uchumi wa Taifa letu ulikua kwa 7% na inakadiriwa kwamba mwaka 2016 uchumi wetu utakua kwa wastani wa 7.2%.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuanzia Januari hadi Setemba, 2016, ukuaji wa pato la Taifa uliongezeka kufikia 6.5% ikilinganishwa na 6.3% katika kipindi kama hicho mwaka 2015. Sekta ambazo zimekua kwa viwango vikubwa ni pamoja na shughuli ya uchimbaji wa madini na mawe, 15.8%; usafirishaji na uhifadhi wa mizigo 15.5%; habari na mawasiliano, 13.4%; na huduma za fedha, 11.5%.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, matarajio ya sasa ni kufikia ukuaji wa wastani wa 7%. Hii inatokana na kuwa, sekta ambazo zinaajiri watu wengi na ambazo zina mchango mkubwa katika uchumi hazikukua kwa kasi ambayo ilitarajiwa ikiwemo Sekta ya Kilimo, ambapo katika hiyo miezi, ilikua kwa wastani wa 2.1% tu wakati matarajio yalikuwa ni 22.6%; na biashara ilikuwa kwa wastani wa 5.6% ikilinganishwa na matarajio ya 7.6%.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa upande wa mfumuko wa bei, ambacho ni kiashiria kingine cha afya ya uchumi wa Taifa letu, mfumuko wa bei ulipungua kutoka 6.5% Januari, 2016 hadi 5.5% Juni, 2016 na kupungua zaidi hadi 4.5% Septemba, 2016 na baadaye umepanda kidogo mwezi Desemba kufikia 5%. Kwa ujumla Mwenendo huu wa kushuka kwa mfumuko wa bei ulichangiwa na kasi ndogo ya kuongezeka kwa bei ya chakula nchini, kushuka kwa wastani wa bei ya mafuta ya petroli katika Soko la Dunia lakini pia utekelezaji wa sera za bajeti na fedha lakini pia utulivu wa shilingi ya Tanzania dhidi ya dola ya Kimarekani.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hata hivyo, mfumuko wa bei, pana uwezekano wa kuongezeka kutokana na hali ya ukame inayojitokeza hapa Tanzania, lakini pia katika baadhi ya nchi za ukanda wa nchi za Afrika Mashariki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kiashiria kingine cha afya ya uchumi ni uimara wa thamani ya shilingi. Thamani ya shilingi dhidi ya dola ya Kimarekani ilipungua kwa kasi ndogo kutoka wastani wa shilingi 2,144.7 kwa dola moja mwezi Desemba, 2015 hadi shilingi 2,170 kwa dola moja mwezi Desemba, 2016. Hata hivyo thamani ya shilingi kwa dola ya Kimarekani ilishuka kufuatia kuimarika kwa dola ya Kimarekani na hii pia iliathiri sarafu nyingine siyo ya Tanzania peke yake, ikiwemo hata Yuan ya China ambayo ilishuka thamani kwa 3.55% kwa kipindi cha miezi 12 kufikia tarehe 19 Januari, 2017.

Kadhalika faranga ya Rwanda nayo iliteremka kwa 8.55% lakini hata pauni ya Kiingereza nayo iliteremka kwa 13.04.%. Dola ya Kimarekani iliimarika kutokana na kupanda kwa kitu kinaitwa Federal Reserve Fund Rate mwezi Desemba, 2016 ambayo iliwafanya wawekezaji kuongeza mahitaji yao ya dola ya Kimarekani.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika kwa upande wa sekta ya nje na akiba ya fedha za kigeni, mwaka 2016 nakisi ya urari wa biashara ya bidhaa huduma na uhamishaji mali nchi za nje (current account deficit) ilipungua kufikia dola za Kimarekani milioni 2,054.8 kutoka nakisi ya dola za Kimarekani milioni 4,011.6 mwaka 2015 na kupungua huko kulitokana zaidi na kuongezeka kwa thamani ya madini, bidhaa asili, mapato yatokanayo na utalii na kupungua kwa thamani ya bidhaa ambazo tunaagiza nje ya nchi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hadi mwezi Desemba, 2016 akiba ya fedha za kigeni imefikia dola za Kimarekani 4325.6 ambazo zinatosheleza kuagiza bidhaa na huduma kutoka nje ya nchi kwa takribani miezi 4.2, na hivyo akiba ya fedha za kigeni imeendelea kuwa ya kuridhisha.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa nieleze mwenendo wa sekta ya kibenki. Tathmini ya hali ya mabenki yetu na taasisi ya fedha inaonesha kuwa mabenki yetu yako imara na salama, yana mitaji na ukwasi wa kutosha. Kiwango cha mitaji ikilinganishwa na mali iliyowekezwa kwa Kiingereza tunasema; total capital to total risk weighted assets and of balance sheet exposures kilikuwa 17.8% kikilinganishwa na kiwango cha chini kinachotakiwa kisheria ambacho ni 10%. Ukwasi ni kiasi cha fedha kilichopo katika uchumi na kwa kawaida inajumlisha fedha taslim na amana katika mabenki, zilizopo Benki Kuu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, utoshelevu wa ukwasi katika uchumi unapimwa kwa kuangalia viashiria mbalimbali, ikiwemo ujazi wa fedha, mwenendo wa mikopo kwa sekta binafsi, kiwango cha mitaji ya mabenki, uwiano kati ya mali inayoweza kubadilishwa kwa fedha taslim na amana zinazoweza kuhitajika katika muda mfupi na upatikanaji wa huduma za kifedha.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pale ambapo imedhihirika kwamba kuna upungufu wa ukwasi katika uchumi, Serikali kupitia Benki Kuu huwa inachukua hatua mbalimbali za kisera ili kuchochea shughuli za kiuchumi; na hatua hizi ni pamoja na kuongeza ujazi wa fedha na kuboresha mazingira kwa sekta binafsi kukopa. Aidha, Serikali kupitia Wizara ya Fedha inaweza kupunguza kodi na kuongeza matumizi ya Serikali baada ya kupata ridhaa ya Bunge.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hali ilivyo sasa, ukiangalia kigezo cha uwiano kati ya mali inayoweza kubadilishwa kuwa fedha taslim na amana zinazoweza kuhitajika kwa muda mfupi, kwa Kiingereza, liquid assets to demand liabilities, uwiano huu ulikuwa 42.4% ikilinganishwa na 37.2% katika kipindi kama hicho mwaka 2015. Kiwango kinachohitajika cha chini kisheria ni 20%. Pia amana za wateja katika mabenki zilipungua kidogo kutoka shilingi trilioni 20.73 mwezi Desemba, 2015 hadi kufikia shilingi trilioni 20.57 mwezi Septemba, 2016.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hata hivyo, amana za Serikali kwenye mabenki ya biashara ni 3% tu ya amana zote za mabenki. Aidha, jumla ya rasilimali za mabenki zimeendelea kuongezeka kutoka shilingi bilioni 26,917.2 mwezi Desemba, 2015 hadi kufikia shilingi bilioni 27,978.2 mwezi Desemba, 2016, sawa na ongezeko la asilimia 2.6.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa upande wa mikopo kwa sekta binafsi, mikopo iliongezeka kwa 7.2% katika kipindi cha mwaka ulioishia Desemba, 2016 ikilinganishwa na ongezeko la 24.8% katika kipindi hicho mwaka 2015. Kupungua kwa kiwango cha ukuaji kilitokana na tahadhari zilizochukuliwa na mabenki
kufuatia kuongezeka kwa mikopo chechefu kutoka 6.4% Desemba, 2015 hadi 9.5% Desemba, 2016.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kupungua kwa kasi ya kuongezeka kwa mikopo kwa sekta binafsi, katika miezi ya hivi karibuni siyo kwa Tanzania peke yake, tumeangalia nchi nyingine kama Kenya, nako tunaona ilipungua kutoka 19.7% kati ya Julai na Oktoba, 2015 hadi 4.1% katika kipindi hicho mwaka 2016.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nchini Uganda mikopo kwa sekta binafsi nayo ilipungua kwa 25.2% mwezi Septemba, 2015 hadi -1% Septemba, 2016. Pia mwenendo usioridhisha unajitokeza katika mikopo chechefu (nonperformaning loans), katika nchi hizo za jirani na kusababisha baadhi ya mabenki kuwekwa chini ya uangalizi kama vile Crane Bank ya kule Uganda. Hali hii tunaona ni mbaya zaidi katika nchi ambazo zinauza mafuta kama Naigeria na Ghana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, upatikanaji wa huduma za kifedha kwa wananchi wasiofikiwa na mabenki umeendelea kuongezeka kutokana na ubunifu na mipango ya utoaji huduma za malipo ya rejareja kupitia simu za kiganjani na huduma za uwakala wa mabenki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, zipo benki zilizopata msukosuko katika robo ya kwanza ya mwaka huu wa fedha, CRDB na TIB Development Bank zilipata hasara na hasara ilisababishwa na tengo kwa ajili ya mikopo chechefu, yaani provision for nonperforming loans. Twiga Bancorp iliwekwa chini ya uangalizi wa Benki Kuu ya Tanzania, lakini licha ya hali hiyo, benki nyingi zikiwemo CRDB yenyewe na TIB Development Bank zimebaki kuwa na mitaji na ukwasi wa kutosha kwa mujibu wa sheria.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pia ni vizuri kukumbuka kwamba jumla ya benki ina taasisi za fedha nchini ziko 66 na zina matawi 783 na hivyo kwa benki tatu kupata msukosuko katika robo moja tu ya mwaka siyo sababu ya kuzua taharuki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niseme kidogo juu ya utoaji wa fedha kwa mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa, katika kipindi cha Julai hadi Desemba, 2016. Serikali inatambua umuhimu wa kupeleka fedha katika Halmashauri zetu maana huko ndiko utekelezaji wa miradi ya maendeleo na utoaji wa huduma mbalimbali kwa wananchi unapofanyika. Katika robo ya kwanza ya 2016/2017 Serikali ilipeleka shilingi bilioni 114.7 kwa ajili ya utekelezaji wa miradi ya maendeleo na matumizi mengineyo.

Aidha, katika robo ya pili ya mwaka Serikali iliongeza mgao wa fedha ziliozoenda kwenye Halmashauri ambapo kiasi cha shilingi bilioni 203.4 zilipelekwa. Serikali itaendelea kupeleka fedha katika Halmashauri kwa kipindi kilichobaki kulingana na bajeti iliyoidhinishwa na Bunge lako Tukufu na kuhakikisha ufanisi katika utekelezaji wa shughuli za Halmashauri ili kuwahudumia wananchi wetu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa upande wa ulipaji wa madai mbalimbali, hadi kufikia tarehe 30 Juni, 2016 kiasi cha shilingi bilioni 3,113.7 ziliwasilishwa ikiwa ni madai ya wakandarasi, watumishi, wazabuni na watoa huduma. Baada ya Serikali kufanya uhakiki kupitia kwa Mkaguzi wa Ndani Mkuu wa Serikali, ilibainika kuwa madeni halali yalikuwa ni shilingi bilioni 2,934.2 na madai yaliyokosa vielelezo na hivyo kukosa uhalali yalikuwa shilingi bilioni 179.5.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, katika kipindi cha nusu mwaka 2016/2017 Serikali imelipa jumla ya shilingi bilioni 600.2 na kati ya kiasi hicho shilingi bilioni 42.35 zilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya madai ya watumishi, shilingi bilioni 49.46 kwa ajili ya wazabuni, shilingi bilioni 11.2 kwa ajili ya watoa huduma, shilingi bilioni 30 kwa ajili ya madai ya vyombo vya ulinzi na usalama na shilingi bilioni 467.2 ni kwa ajili ya wakandarasi mbalimbali ikijumuisha shilingi bilioni mbili kwa ajili ya makandarasi wa maghala na skimu za maji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuhusu madeni ya pembejeo, Serikali bado inaendelea na uhakiki wa madeni hayo ili kubaini madeni halali na yasiyo halali. Hata hivyo, katika kipindi cha Julai mpaka Desemba, 2016 Serikali imetoa jumla ya shilingi bilioni 10 kwa ajili ya ruzuku ya pembejeo. Aidha, katika kuhakikisha madai ya wakandarasi, wazabuni, watumishi na watoa huduma wa ndani yanapewa kipaumbele, Serikali imeweka mkakati wa kutenga fedha kila mwezi ambapo mwezi Januari, 2017 Serikali imetenga jumla ya shilingi bilioni 70 kwa ajili hiyo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuhusu mwenendo wa deni la Taifa; deni la Taifa linajumuisha mikopo ambayo hukopwa na Serikali kutoka nje na ndani ya nchi kwa ajili ya kutekeleza miradi ya maendeleo pamoja na kujaza nakisi ya bajeti. Deni la nje hukopa kutoka kwenye taasisi za kifedha kama Benki ya Dunia, nchi wahisani na pia kutoka kwenye benki za biashara, wakati deni la ndani linapatikana kwa kuuza dhamana za Serikali (treasury bills) na hati fungani (treasury bonds). Mikopo kutoka Benki Kuu ya Tanzania na benki za biashara za ndani.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hadi kufikia Desemba, 2016 deni la Taifa ikijumuisha deni la ndani na la nje, lilifikia dola za Kimarekani milioni 19,021.9. Hiyo ndiyo dead stock ikilinganishwa na dola za Kimarekani milioni 18,459.3 mwezi Juni, 2016 ambayo ni sawa na ongezeko la asilimia 3.05, na ongezeko la deni hilo limetokana na mikopo iliyopo na mikopo mipya iliyopokelewa na Serikali na ambayo bado haijaiva, kutoka mikopo ya ndani na nje ya nchi kwa ajili ya kugharamia miradi mbalimbali ya maendeleo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, miradi ambayo iligharamiwa na mikopo hiyo imeelezewa kwa kina katika kitabu cha uchambuzi wa deni la Taifa pamoja na miradi iliyofadhiliwa na deni hilo toka uhuru.Tumeandaa kitabu ambacho Waheshimiwa Wabunge watagawiwa ambacho kinatoa taarifa ya uchambuzi wa deni la Taifa na miradi yote iliyofadhiliwa na deni hilo tangu uhuru.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ulipaji wa deni la Taifa hauangalii ukubwa wa deni lililopo (debt stock) bali kadri deni linavyoiva (debt maturity). Hali hiyo sasa, sehemu kubwa ya deni la Taifa inaiva kwa kipindi cha muda mrefu (long term maturity) na kutokana na hali hiyo wastani (average time to maturity) kwa deni lililopo sasa litaiva kwa kipindi cha miaka takribani 12. Hali hii inaashiria kwamba athari zake kwenye bajeti ziko chini (low re-finance risk).

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali imekuwa ikilipa madeni ya nje na ndani kwa mujibu wa mikataba. Katika kipindi cha kuanzia Julai, 2016 hadi Desemba, 2016 Serikali ilitumia jumla ya shilingi bilioni 2,570.1 kulipa madeni ya ndani na nje yaliyoiva; na kati ya kiasi hicho, deni la ndani ni shilingi bilioni 1,822.3 na deni la nje ni shilingi bilioni 747.8. Malipo ya deni la ndani yanajumuisha malipo ya mtaji (roll over) ya shilingi bilioni 1,367.1 na malipo ya riba shilingi milioni 455.2.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, dhamira ya Serikali ni kuendelea kulipa kwa wakati mikopo yote ya nje inayoiva kwa mujibu wa sheria, maana tusipolipa kuna athari kubwa za kutolipa. Baadhi ya athari hizo ni kwamba, nchi itahatarisha mahusiano yaliyopo kati yake na nchi wahisani; taasisi za fedha za Kimataifa na mabenki ya nje; nchi inaweza kushitakiwa kwenye Mahakama za Kimataifa na kuisababishia hasara na kutopata mikopo; kukamatwa kwa mali zake zilizopo nje na ndani ili kulipia madeni ambayo hayajalipwa; na kulipa gharama za ziada kama adhabu (Penalty) kulingana na makubaliano na hivyo kuongeza mzigo wa deni kwa Taifa letu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba ifahamike kwamba malipo yote ya mikopo ya ndani na nje yanakasimiwa kwenye Fungu Na. 22 na kwa kuzingatia utaratibu wa kibajeti, matumizi yote yaliyokasimiwa katika fungu hili ni matumizi

yasiyoepukika (first charge). Kutokana na utaratibu huo wa kibajeti na athari nilizozieleza hapo awali, kutolipa mikopo kulingana na mikataba, malipo yote ya mikopo ya ndani na nje hulipwa kwa wakati pindi yanapoiva.

Aidha, kwa upande wa madai ya ndani ya wakandarasi, wazabuni, watumishi na watoa huduma, malipo yake hukasimiwa kwenye mafungu mengine ya Wizara, Mikoa na Halmashauri ambayo hayapo katika kundi la matumizi yasiyoepukika na hivyo, madai haya hulipwa baada ya uhakiki kukamilika. Sambamba na ulipaji wa Deni la Taifa, Serikali imeendelea kugharamia utoaji wa huduma nyingine mbalimbali kwa jamii na utekelezaji wa miradi ya maendeleo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, niseme juu ya tathmini ya uhimilivu wa Deni la Taifa. Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Mikopo, Dhamana na Misaada, Sura ya 134, Serikali ina wajibu wa kufanya tathmini ya uhimilivu wa deni (Debt Sustainability Analysis) kila mwaka ili kupima hali ya deni na uhimilivu wake. Kwa kuzingatia matakwa ya sheria, nilivyosema, Wataalamu wamekamilisha tathmini ya uhimilivu wa Deni la Taifa kwa mwaka 2016/2017 na matokeo ya tathmini hiyo yanaonesha kuwa deni ni himilivu kwa muda mfupi, muda wa kati na muda mrefu. Matokeo haya yanafanana na yale yaliyotolewa katika Taarifa ya IMF ya Uhimilivu wa Deni la Taifa iliyotolewa Juni, 2016.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, katika hiyo tathmini ya Novemba, 2016 viashiria vinaonesha kuwa, thamani ya sasa ya jumla ya Deni la Taifa (Present Value of Total Public Debt) kwa pato la Taifa ni 34.2% ikilinganishwa na ukomo wa 56%. Thamani ya sasa ya Deni la Nje pekee (Net Present Value of External Debt) kwa Pato la Taifa ni 19.9% ikilinganishwa na ukomo wa 40%. Thamani ya sasa ya Deni la Nje kwa Mauzo ya Nje ni 97.7% ikilinganishwa na ukomo wa 150% na thamani ya sasa ya Deni la Nje kwa Mapato ya Ndani ni 145.3% ikilinganishwa na ukomo wa 250%.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa kuzingatia vigezo hivyo, uwiano wa deni lote la ndani na nje kwa thamani ya sasa kwa pato la Taifa (Present Value of Total Public Debt to GDP) kwa mwaka 2015/2016 Kenya lilikuwa 45.6%, Tanzania 34.2%, Uganda 24.1%, Rwanda 22.7%. Pia uwiano wa deni la nje kwa thamani ya sasa kwa Pato la Taifa Kenya ilikuwa 19.4%, Tanzania 19.9%, Uganda 10.7%, Rwanda 17.3% ambavyo vyote viko chini ya ukomo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali inaendelea kuchukua hatua mbalimbali kuhakikisha kwamba Deni la Taifa linadhibitiwa na linaendelea kuwa himilivu. Katika kuhakikisha uwazi na uwajibikaji katika usimamizi wa Deni la Taifa,

Mdhibiti na Mkaguzi Mkuu wa Hesabu za Serikali anaendelea kufanya ukaguzi maalum na yupo katika hatua za mwisho za kukamilisha taarifa ambayo itatoa hali halisi ya Deni la Taifa.Kama tulivyoona katika viashiria mbalimbali vya kiuchumi, uchumi wa Tanzania uko imara na tulivu; mfumuko wa bei umedhibitiwa katika wigo wa tarakimu moja, benki zetu bado zina ukwasi wa kutosha kuweza kukopesha wananchi na deni la Taifa linaendelea kuwa himilivu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, taarifa huru ya IMF ambayo imetolewa tarehe 9 Januri, 2017 inathibitisha ukweli huu kwa kusema, na ninanukuu: „Tanzanian‟s microeconomic performance remains strong, economic growth was robust during the first half of 2016 and is projected to remain at about 7% this fiscal year. Inflation came down below the authority‟s target of 5% and is expected to remain close to that target while the external current account deficit was revised downward on account of lower imports of capital goods.” Mwisho wa kunukuu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ziko changamoto kadhaa ambazo Serikali inaendelea kuzifanyia kazi na ambazo ziko ndani ya uwezo wa Serikali. Ninawasihi Waheshimiwa Wabunge tushirikiane kwa pamoja katika masuala yote ya maendeleo ya nchi yetu na tutumie taarifa rasmi katika kuwafikishia wananchi ujumbe ulio sahihi. Aidha, kama nilivyoeleza awali, napenda kuwahakikishia Waheshimiwa Wabunge na Watanzania kwa ujumla kwamba uchumi wetu ni tulivu, uko imara na tunategemea utaendelea kuwa hivyo katika kipindi cha muda wa kati. Nirudie kuwahakikishia kuwa hakuna mdororo wa uchumi nchini.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba kuwasilisha.
Ahsante Mheshimiwa Waziri kwa Kauli hiyo.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, tunaendelea, Katibu!
MISWADA YA SERIKALI
Muswada wa Sheria ya Huduma ya Msaada wa Kisheria
wa Mwaka 2016 (The Legal Aid Bill, 2016)
Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Katiba na Sheria.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba nianze kwa kumshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu aliyetujalia afya njema, kukutana tena hapa siku ya leo tunapoendelea kujadili masuala muhimu ya Kitaifa kwa maendeleo ya wananchi na Taifa kwa ujumla. Vilevile naushukuru uongozi wa Bunge kwa kunipa fursa kuwasilisha Muswada huu leo asubuhi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, aidha, nawapongeza Wahesnimiwa, Alhaji Abdallah Bulembo, Anne Kilango Malecela na Profesa Palamagamba Kabudi kwa kula Kiapo cha Uaminifu leo Bungeni kufuatia uteuzi wao kuwa Wabunge wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania uliofanywa na Rais wa Nchi. Nampongeza vilevile Mheshimiwa Dkt. Abdallah Possi kwa kuteuliwa na Mheshimiwa Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania kuwa Balozi. Pia, nampongeza Mheshimiwa Juma Ali Juma aliyechaguliwa kwa kishindo kuwa Mbunge wa Dimani, kupitia Chama cha Mapinduzi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa namna ya pekee napenda kuishukuru Kamati ya Kudumu ya Bunge ya Katiba na Sheria chini ya Uongozi wa Mheshimiwa Mohamed Mchengerwa, Mbunge wa Rufiji na Makamu wake Mheshimiwa Najma Murtaza Giga, Mbunge wa Viti Maalum. Kamati hii imeutendea haki Muswada huu kwani imeuchambua na kuujadili kwa kina kwa lengo la kuuboresha, ili hatimaye tupate sheria bora itakayowasaidia wananchi, hususan wa kipato cha chini na wa vijijini kuifikia haki hii.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, napenda kuihakikishia Kamati na Bunge lako Tukufu kuwa, kwa asilimia kubwa tumezingatia maoni, michango na ushauri tulioupata ambao umesaidia sana kuimarisha maudhui ya Muswada huu kama inavyoonekana kwenye jedwali la marekebisho ya Serikali. Vilevile naishukuru Ofisi ya Mwanasheria Mkuu wa Serikali pamoja na Watumishi wa Bunge kwa ushirikiano mkubwa walioipa Wizara yangu katika maandalizi na uandishi wa

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nitakuwa mchoyo wa fadhila nisipowashukuru wadau mbalimbali kutoka taasisi na asasi za kiraia zinazotoa huduma ya msaada wa kisheria nchini, kama vile Chama cha Wanasheria cha Tanganyika (TLS), Chama cha Wanasheria Wanawake (TAWLA), Kituo cha Msaada wa Kisheria kwa Wanawake (WILAC), Mfuko wa Huduma za Kisheria (LSF), Taasisi ya Watu wenye Ulemavu ya Msaada wa Kisheria na Maendeleo ya Jamii (DOLASED), Kamati ya Msaada wa Kisheria ya Chuo Kikuu cha Dar es Salaam (LAC), Mtandao wa Wasaidizi wa Kisheria (TAPANET), Sekretariet ya Msaada wa Kisheria (LAS), Kituo cha Sheria na Haki za Binadamu (LHRC) na wengine.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, taasisi na asasi hizi zimeshirikiana kwa kiasi kikubwa na Serikali, hususan Wizara yangu, katika kufikia maelewano na nia moja ya kuhakikisha tunapata sheria muafaka ya msaada wa kisheria ili kukata kiu ya muda mrefu ya hitaji la sheria hii. Kwa kifupi Muswada huu umetokana na ushirikishwaji mpana sana wa wadau wengi na ninasema ahsanteni sana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Muswada huu wa Sheria ya Msaada wa Kisheria, umepitia hatua nyingi sana na umechukua muda mrefu hadi kufikia hatua hii ya kujadiliwa na Bunge lako Tukufu. Ni zaidi ya miaka kumi kumekuwa na hitaji la kuwa na sheria hii. Aidha, napenda kuchukua fursa hii kuwashukuru Mawaziri wenzangu walionitangulia katika Wizara hii kwa msingi mzuri walioujenga ambao nimeutumia kumalizia kazi hii ambayo inakwenda kumaliza kwa kiasi kikubwa kilio cha muda mrefu cha wananchi wasiokuwa na uwezo wa kumudu gharama za Mawakili katika kuifikia haki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Muswada huu unapendekeza kutungwa kwa Sheria ya Msaada wa Kisheria kwa lengo la kuanzisha kwa mara ya kwanza katika historia ya nchi yetu mfumo wa kisheria wa kusimamia, kuratibu, kurasimisha na kutambua utoaji wa huduma ya msaada wa kisheria katika mashauri yote ya jinai na mashauri ya madai kwa wahitaji. Utaratibu tuliokuwanao kwa miaka mingi kama Serikali, unahusu baadhi tu ya makosa ya jinai, makosa yenye adhabu kubwa kama vile ya kunyongwa hadi kufa na vifungo virefu. Huduma hiyo imekuwa ikitolewa katika ngazi ya Mahakama Kuu pekee na kwa wigo mdogo tu pale inapohitajika kwa maslahi ya haki na kwa maelekezo ya Jaji Mkuu au yeyote yule aliyekasimiwa mamlaka ya kutoa maelekezo hayo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa upande wa mashauri ya madai, huduma ya msaada wa kisheria imekuwa ikitolewa na asasi za kiraia na mashirika yasiyokuwa ya kiserikali tu, kuanzia ushauri wa kisheria, kuandaa nyaraka za kimahakama na hata uwakilishi Mahakamani. Hata hivyo, kazi hii imekuwa

ikifanywa pasipokuwa na uratibu na usimamizi wa utoaji wa huduma hiyo baina ya taasisi, asasi hizo za Serikali, jambo linalosababisha watu wasiokuwa na taaluma ya sheria, makanjanja, vishoka, kuivamia fani na kuharibu sifa nzuri ya taaluma ya sheria inayojengeka miongoni mwa jamii yetu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kimsingi kupitia Muswada huu mfumo wa uratibu katika utoaji huduma hii unaanzishwa na dhana ya utoaji msaada wa kisheria inapanuka kuhusisha utoaji wa elimu kwa Umma kuhusu masuala ya sheria na haki, kushauri, kuandaa nyaraka za Mahakama, kusuluhisha migogoro na uwakilishi Mahakamani.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kumekuwepo miaka ya hivi karibuni, ongezeko kubwa la mahitaji ya huduma ya msaada wa kisheria, ongezeko la idadi ya watoa huduma ya msaada wa kisheria na wasaidizi wa kisheria. Kutokana na hali hii, Serikali imeona ulazima wa kuanzisha mfumo huu wa kusimamia na kuratibu utoaji wa huduma hii ili kuhakikisha inatolewa na watu wenye sifa, inatolewa kwa wahitaji halisi na kwa taratibu zinazofahamika na Serikali kuwa na uwezo wa kuona na kutathmini huduma inayotolewa, ili iendane na matakwa ya Kikatiba, hususan Ibara ya 13 ya Katiba ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania inayosisitiza usawa mbele ya sheria bila ubaguzi wowote.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pamoja na matakwa haya ya Kikatiba, endapo Bunge lako litaipitisha sheria hii siyo tu kwamba nchi yetu itatambuliwa Kimataifa, kutekeleza masuala ya haki za binadamu, bali vilevile tutakuwa tukitekeleza kwa vitendo mikataba na maazimio mbalimbali ya Kimataifa kuhusu umuhimu wa utoaji wa huduma ya msaada wa kisheria.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Mikataba hiyo ni pamoja na Mkataba wa Haki za Kiraia na Kisiasa wa mwaka 1966, Mkataba wa Afrika wa Haki za Binadamu na Umma wa mwaka 1986, Azimio la Lilongwe la Msaada wa Kisheria la Mwaka 2004, Tamko la Lilongwe kuhusu Uwezeshaji Wananachi Kuifikia Huduma ya Msaada wa Kisheria katika Mfumo wa Haki Jinai wa mwaka 2004 na Azimio la Umoja wa Mataifa kuhusu Kanuni na Miongozo ya Umoja wa Mataifa ya Namna ya Kuifikia Haki katika Mfumo wa Haki Jinai wa mwaka 2012.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa mantiki hiyo, Muswada huu unalenga kukidhi matakwa ya Katiba yetu na ya mikataba mbalimbali ya Kimataifa ambayo tumeridhia sisi wenyewe. Kwa Muswada huu tunaweka mfumo madhubuti na endelevu wa msaada wa kisheria ambao utaziba ombwe lililopo la usimamizi na udhibiti na kutoa kwa kiasi kikubwa suluhisho la changamoto ya muda mrefu ya Watanzania wengi kutojua sheria hivyo haki, fursa na wajibu

wao kisheria. Mfumo unaowekwa na sheria inayopendekezwa unakusudia kuhakikisha kuwa huduma ya msaada wa kisheria nchini inaleta matokeo chanya kwa ustawi wa wananchi, hususan wa vijijini na wasiokuwa na uwezo wa kumudu gharama za Mawakili wa kujitegemea.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pamoja na mambo mengine, Muswada huu pia, umelenga kuwatambua Wasaidizi wa Kisheria. Unafuta sheria ya Msaada wa Kisheria katika Mashauri ya Jinai, Sura ya 21 na kuweka masharti mengine yanayohusiana na hayo. Muswada huu umegawanyika katika Sehemu kuu nane, kama ifuatavyo:-

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya kwanza ya Muswada ina Ibara ya kuanzia ya 1, 2 na 3 ambazo zinahusu masharti ya awali ambayo ni Jina la Sheria inayopendekezwa; eneo la kutumika kwa sheria husika katika Jamhuri ya Muungano; na mwanzo wa kutumika na tafsiri ya maneno mbalimbali yaliyotumika katika Muswada unaopendekezwa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya pili ambayo ina Ibara ya 4, 5, 6, 7 na 8 inaweka masharti kuhusu usimamizi na uratibu wa watoa msaada wa kisheria. Aidha, sehemu hii inaanzisha Bodi ya Ushauri ya Msaada wa Kisheria na kuainisha majukumu ya Bodi hiyo. Vilevile sehemu hii inaunda nafasi ya Msajili wa Watoa Huduma za Msaada wa Kisheria, uteuzi wake na majukumu yake. Inaweka pia nafasi za Wasajili Wasaidizi katika ngazi za Mkoa na Wilaya na taratibu pamoja na masharti ya kazi zao.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya tatu yenye Ibara kuanzia ya 9 hadi 18 inahusu masharti ya usajili wa Watoa Msaada wa Kisheria. Ni katika sehemu hii ambapo zimeainishwa sifa mtu kusajiliwa kama Mtoa Msaada wa Kisheria. Utoaji wa cheti cha usajili mara baada ya kusajiliwa kama mtoa msaada wa kisheria, mazingira yatakayosababisha kusitishwa au kufutwa kwa cheti cha usajili na haki ya rufaa dhidi ya uamuzi wa kusitishwa au kufutwa kwa cheti.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya nne ambayo ina Ibara za 19 na 20 inahusu masharti mahususi kwa wasaidizi wa kisheria, sifa, majukumu na masharti ya wasaidizi wa kisheria, kutoa ushauri kwa mujibu wa masharti ya Muswada unaopendekezwa. Sifa zilizoainishwa kwa msaidizi wa kisheria zitasaidia wananchi wengi sana kufikiwa na huduma hii kutokana na sifa hizo kuwa ni za ngazi ya chini kabisa kielimu.

Hata hivyo, kila Msaidizi wa Sheria atapitia mafunzo maalum ya sheria kwa mtaala ambao ulishaandaliwa na Chama cha Wanasheria cha Tanganyika. Tayari Wasaidizi wa Sheria zaidi ya 4,700 wamepatiwa mafunzo hayo. Sehemu hii ya Muswada inatoa katazo kwa Wasaidizi wa Kisheria kutoza ada kwa mtu anayesaidiwa na kuwakataza kujihusisha na shughuli zilizotengwa kwa ajili ya Mawakili wa Kujitegemea.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya tano ina Ibara kuanzia ya 21 hadi 36. Sehemu hii inaweka masharti ya mtu anayeweza kuomba msaada wa kisheria, masharti ya jumla ya msaada wa kisheria na msaada wa kisheria katika mashauri ya madai na jinai kwa amri ya Mahakama na Mabaraza mbalimbali yanayojihusisha na utoaji haki. Aidha, sehemu hii inatoa masharti ya upatikanaji wa msaada wa kisheria kwa watoto na watu walio katika Vituo vya Polisi, Magereza na vizuizi mbalimbali.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya sita ya Muswada ina Ibara za 37, 38 na 40. Sehemu hii inahusu masuala ya fedha na inajumuisha masharti yahusuyo vyanzo vya mapato bodi, makadirio ya mwaka na vitabu vya hesabu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya saba iliyo na Ibara kuanzia 41 hadi 45 inahusu masharti mengineyo. Aidha, inatoa masharti kuhusu mamlaka ya Msajili kutoa tangazo kwa mtoa msaada wa kisheria kuthibitisha uwepo wake, wajibu kuhusiana na miiko ya maadili ya kitaaluma kwa watoa msaada wa kisheria na mamlaka ya Waziri kutunga kanuni kwa lengo la utekelezaji bora wa sheria na kanuni za maadili ya watoa msaada wa kisheria na wasaidizi wa kisheria.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sehemu ya nane ambayo ina Ibara ya 46 hadi Ibara ya 50 inatoa masharti yatokanayo na masharti ya mpito. Aidha, sehemu hii inafuta sheria ya msaada wa kisheria katika mashauri ya jinai sura ya 21 pamoja na kuainisha masharti ya mpito na yatokanayo kuhusu shughuli zote za huduma ya msaada wa kisheria zilizokuwa zinaendelea kabla ya kupitishwa kwa sheria ya msaada wa kisheria.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, baada ya maelezo hayo, naliomba Bunge lako Tukufu liujadili Muswada wa Sheria ya Huduma a Msaada wa Kisheria na kuupitisha kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya Taifa letu.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naafiki.
Hoja imeungwa mkono. Tutaendelea na utaratibu mpaka tutakapofika wakati wa kulihoji Bunge.

A Bill
for
An Act to regulate and coordinate the provision of legal aid services to indigent
persons, to recognise paralegals, to repeal the Legal Aid (Criminal
Proceedings) Act and to provide for other related matters.
ENACTED by Parliament of the United Republic of Tanzania
PART I
PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS
Short title and 1. This Act may be cited as the Legal Aid Act, commencement 2016 and shall come into operation on such date as
the Minister may, by notice published in the Gazette,
appoint.
Application 2. This Act shall apply to Mainland Tanzania. Interpretation 3. In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires:
„advocate” means a practicing advocate;
„aided person” means a person who has been
granted legal aid under this Act;
„Assistant Registrar” means Assistant Registrar referred
to under section 8;
„Board” means the Board established under section 4;
„Chief Court Administrator” means the Chief Court Cap. 237 Administrator appointed under the Judiciary
Administration Act;
„indigent person” means a person whose means are
insufficient to enable him to engage a private
legal practitioner and includes other categories
of persons where the interests of justice so
require;
„legal advice and assistance” means an advice or
assistance provided to the indigent person on
criminal and civil cases based on the relevant
law, legal process, procedures and drafting of
documents as may be required;
„legal aid” or „legal aid service” includes the provision
of legal advice, assistance or representation to
indigent persons;
„legal aid provider” means an institution that has been
registered under this Act to provide legal aid;
„Minister” means the Minister responsible for legal
affairs;
„paralegal” means a person who provides legal aid
services under the legal aid provider;
„Permanent Secretary” means a Permanent Secretary
of the Ministry responsible for legal affairs; and
„Registrar” means the Registrar referred to under
section 6;
„Register” means a Register of Legal Aid providers
established under this Act.
PART II
ADMINISTRATION AND COORDINATION OF LEGAL AID PROVIDERS Establishment of 4.-(1) There shall is established a Board to be the Board known as the National Legal Aid Advisory Board.
(2) The provisions of the Schedule to this Act shall
have effect as to the composition of the Board, tenure
of office, proceedings at meetings of the Board and
other matters relating to the Board.
(3) Save for the composition of the Board, the
Minister shall have power to amend, alter or vary the
Schedule.
Functions of the 5.-(1) The functions of the Board shall be to- Board (a) provide policy guidelines to legal aid
providers;
(b) advise the Minister on policy and other
matters of relevance with respect to
improving legal aid provision;
(c) approve the annual reports of legal aid
providers;
(d) determine appeals from the decision of the
Registrar;
(e) perform such other functions as may be
directed by the Minister.
(2) In performing its functions under this Act, the
Board shall maintain as far as practicable, a system of
consultation and cooperation with Ministries,
Government institutions, legal aid providers or any
other public or private bodies established under any
written law.
The Registrar of 6.-(1) There shall be the Registrar of legal aid legal aid providers.
(2) The Director responsible for legal aid matters
in the Ministry responsible for legal affairs shall be the
Registrar.
Functions of the 7.-(1) The functions and duties of the Registrar Registrar shall be to-
(a) register legal aid providers;
(b) investigate complaints of malpractice,
negligence, misconduct or disobedience
against legal aid providers;
(c) suspend or cancel registration of any legal
aid provider;
(d) keep and maintain the Register of legal aid
providers;
(e) inspect any legal aid provider‟s office with a
view to satisfying himself on the type and
quality of legal aid services offered;
(f) take appropriate measures for promoting
legal literacy and legal awareness among
the public and, in particular, educate
vulnerable sections of the society about their
rights and duties under the Constitution and
other laws;
(g) coordinate and facilitate formulation and
accreditation of curriculum for training of
paralegals;
(h) coordinate, monitor and evaluate the
functions of legal aid providers and give
general and specific directions for the
proper implementation of legal aid
programmes;
(i) keep records and reports regarding legal aid
providers;
(j) prepare various reports on legal aid services
and other matters for submission before the
Board;
(k) facilitate information sharing in accessible
format and providing guidelines for
networking between legal aid providers and
the Government; and
(l) determine disputes between legal aid
providers other than advocates, and
between legal aid providers and aided
persons;
(m) perform any other functions as may be
directed by the Minister or the Board as the
case may be.
(2) The Registrar shall be the Secretary to the Board.
(3) The Registrar shall in the performance and discharge of his functions and duties under this Act-
(a) be assisted by such number of officers of the
Ministry responsible for legal affairs as may be
determined; and
(b) be answerable to the Permanent Secretary
who shall be the link between the
Government and legal aid providers.
Appointment of 8.-(1) The Permanent Secretary shall, for the Assistant Registrars purpose of facilitating registration of legal aid
providers at the regional and district levels and after
consultation with relevant authority, designate for
each region or each district, a public officer from
amongst public officers within the region or district to
be the Assistant Registrar.
(2) Save for section 11(5), the Assistant Registrar
appointed under subsection (1) shall, on behalf of the
Registrar, register legal aid provider within the region or
district for which he is appointed and issue certificates
of registration.
(3) The Assistant Registrar appointed under this
section shall, in the performance of his functions under
this Act, be answerable to the Registrar.
PART III
REGISTRATION OF LEGAL AID PROVIDERS Register of legal aid 9.-(1) There shall be a Register of legal aid providers providers which shall contain the names of institutions
providing legal aid, the services provided and such
other particulars or matters as may be prescribed.
(2) The Registrar shall cause the Register,
whether in printed or electronic form, to be available
to members of the public at police stations, courts,
prisons and such other public places as may be
determined by the Minister.
Qualifications for 10.-(1) An institution shall not be registered as a registration as a legal aid provider unless it has the following legal aid provider qualifications-
(a) it has been registered under the relevant
laws;
(b) the provision of legal aid services is one of its
core functions;
(c) it has office premises and office facilities;
(d) it has not less than-
(i) two advocates;
(ii) one advocate and two paralegals; or
(iii) three paralegals; and
(e) it has been cleared by the body that has
registered it as to its records pertaining to
management of finances.
(2) Subject to the provisions of subsection (1), an
institution with no advocate shall be required to furnish
proof of affiliation with another legal aid provider
which has an advocate before being registered.
(3) Without prejudice to the generality of
subsection (1), the provisions of paragraphs (a) and
(b) shall not apply to institutions established by an Act
of Parliament or any academic institution accredited
under any written law.
Application for 11.-(1) Subject to the provisions of section 10, an registration institution applying for registration under this Act shall
apply in the manner prescribed in the regulations.
(2) Without prejudice to the generality of
subsection (1), an application for registration shall be
accompanied by-
(a) a copy of the constitution of the institution or
any other document establishing the
institution;
(b) personal particulars of office bearers,
advocates or paralegals;
(c) particulars relating to address and physical
location of the head office of the institution;
(d) a copy of a certificate of clearance from a
legal provider‟s registering authority;
(e) an application fee prescribed in the
regulations; and
(f) any other particulars or information as may
be required by the Registrar.
(3) Where an institution intends to operate as a
legal aid provider in more than one district or in the
whole region, an application for its registration shall be
submitted to the Assistant Registrar designated for that
region.
(4) Where an institution intends to operate as a
legal aid provider within a certain district, an
application for its registration shall be submitted to the
Assistant Registrar for that district.
(5) Where an institution intends to operate as a
legal aid provider in more than one region or it has
been registered out of the country, an application for
its registration shall be submitted to the Registrar.
(6) Where the Assistant Registrar has registered a
legal aid provider, he shall make a report to that
effect and submit that report to the Registrar.
(7) The Minister shall, by regulations, prescribe
the procedures for registration and operations of legal
aid providers at regional and district levels in terms of
this Act.
Determination of 12.-(1) The Registrar or as the case may be applications Assistant Registrar, shall consider and make
determination of an application for registration within
thirty days after receiving the application.
(2) Pursuant to the provisions of subsection (1), in
determining the application, the Registrar or as the
case may be Assistant Registrar, may register or refuse
to register an institution as a legal aid provider. Refusal of 13.-(1) The Registrar or Assistant Registrar may registration refuse to register an institution as a legal aid provider if
he is satisfied that-
(a) it has not met the conditions prescribed
under section 10; or
(b) it has given false or fraudulent information in
any material particular.
(2) Where the Registrar or Assistant Registrar has
refused to register an institution as a legal aid provider,
he shall, within twenty one days from the date of such
decision, notify the applicant of the reasons for such
refusal.
Appeals 14.-(1) An institution which is not satisfied with the
decision under section 13 may, within twenty one
days:
(a) in the case of decision of Assistant Registrar,
appeal to the Registrar; and
(b) in the case of decision of the Registrar,
appeal to the Board.
(2) The institution which is aggrieved by the
decision of the Board may, within thirty days from the
date of receiving such decision, appeal to the
Minister.
(3) The Minister shall, within thirty days from the
date of receiving the appeal consider and determine
the appeal.
Certificate of 15.-(1) The Registrar, or Assistant Registrar shall, registration after registration of an institution as a legal aid provider
and upon payment prescribed fee issue a certificate
of registration in the form prescribed in the regulations.
(2) The certificate of registration shall contain-
(a) the name and address of the legal aid
provider;
(b) the area of operation of the legal aid
provider;
(c) legal status of the institution; and
(d) such terms and conditions in respect of which
a certificate is issued.
(3) A certificate of registration issued under
subsection (1) shall be a conclusive evidence for the
institution to operate as a legal aid provider under this
Act.

Suspension and 16.-(1) Subject to the provisions of section 17, the cancellation of Registrar may issue a written warning, suspend or certificates cancel a certificate of registration of the legal aid
provider.
(2) The Registrar may suspend a certificate of
registration of a legal aid provider, if he is satisfied that-
(a) the legal aid provider has committed a
professional misconduct or has failed to
admonish its employee for professional
misconduct or breach of the code of
conduct prescribed by the relevant
professional body;
(b) the legal aid provider is in breach of the
code of conduct prescribed under this Act or
under any other written law this;
(c) the legal aid provider operates in variance to
its constitution;
(d) the legal aid provider has failed to keep
proper records of activities undertaken on
behalf of an aided person and the Registrar
considers that this shall have an adverse
effect on the interests of the aided person
generally or in any particular case.
(3) The Registrar may cancel a certificate of registration of a legal aid provider if he is satisfied that-
(a) the registration was obtained by mistake,
fraud, undue influence or misrepresentation;
(b) the legal aid provider has failed to comply
with the conditions of the registration;
(c) the qualifications for registration has ceased
to exist in respect of the legal aid provider;
(d) the office bearer of the legal aid provider has
been declared bankrupt, is insolvent or has
entered into an arrangement with his
creditors;
(e) an advocate or paralegal employed by a
legal aid provider has regularly breached
professional conduct;
(f) a legal aid provider has engaged in any
political activities;
(g) the office bearer of the legal aid provider is
convicted of an offence which touches on
his integrity, accountability, or is subject to an
order made under the relevant body; or
(h) the legal aid provider is not providing, or has
not provided, the service for which he is
registered to the prescribed standard.
(4) Where the Registrar suspends or cancels certificate of registration, he shall-
(a) notify the relevant legal aid provider of the
decision and order such legal aid provider to
stop operations; or
(b) as the case may be, remove the name of the

legal aid provider from the register. Procedure for 17.-(1) Where a legal aid provider is in default of suspension or the terms and conditions in respect of which a cancellation certificate was issued or is in violation of section 16, the
Registrar may serve to the legal aid provider a default
notice in writing specifying the nature of the default.
(2) Upon receipt of the default notice, a legal
aid provider shall make representation in writing to the
Registrar regarding remedy or rectification of the
default.
(3) Where a legal aid provider has failed to
remedy or rectify the default within time specified in
the default notice or has not made a representation
satisfactory to the Registrar, the Registrar shall suspend
or cancel a certificate.
(4) A legal aid provider whose certificate has
been suspended or cancelled may apply to the
Registrar for review of the decision to suspend or
cancel the certificate if he is dissatisfied by the reasons
for such suspension or cancellation.
(5) A legal aid provider who is aggrieved by the
decision of the Registrar to suspend or cancel a
certificate may appeal to the Board in accordance
with the provisions of section 14. Supervision of legal 18.-(1) The Assistant Registrar shall, for purposes aid providers of this Act, be a supervisor of legal aid providers in the
respective region or district.
(2) In the discharge of supervisory duties, the
Assistant Registrar shall-
(a) exercise general supervision in accordance
with the provisions of this Act;
(b) investigate complaints of malpractice,
negligence, misconduct or disobedience
and make a report to the Registrar of the
facts and circumstances of any such
complaints; and
(c) submit to the Registrar, on annual basis,
names of legal aid providers who have
ceased to practice.

OBJECTS AND REASONS

At present there is no legal aid framework in the country to regulate and coordinate the provision of legal aid. The State provides limited assistance to accused persons being tried for capital offences such as murder, manslaughter and treason. However, such assistance is mainly limited to the High Court. Various civil society organisations provide for some services ranging from legal advice to legal representation in court. This work is not coordinated between the various organisations and the Government. The schemes run by the civil society organisations are heavily dependent on donor funding which are not always forthcoming and thus impacts negatively on sustainability. Further, the increase of legal aid providers and paralegals attracts the need to have them regulated and coordinated.

Thus, the Bill seeks to introduce a comprehensive legal framework that will fill the gap and work as a solution in eliminating the preceeding challenges and ensuring that legal aid in the country brings about positive impact in the welfare of individuals especially indigent persons.
For the purpose of appreciating the intended objectives, the Bill is divided into Seven Parts.

Part I contains preliminary provisions which include short title, application and interpretation of various term used in the proposed Bill. Part II provides for the provisions on administration and coordination of legal aid providers, establishes Legal Aid Advisory Board and its function, also provides for the designation of the Registrar and his functions. Further, it provides for the appointment of the Assistant Registrars and registration of legal aid providers at regional and district level.

Part III provides for the provisions on registration for legal aid providers, outlines the qualifications for registration as legal aid provider, issuance of a certificate of registration to a legal aid provider, circumstances which will lead to suspension or cancellation of certificate of registration, rights to appeal against the decision of suspension or cancelation of certificate. Part IV of the Bill provides for special provisions on paralegals, their qualifications, duties and the requirement of paralegals to provide legal advice and assistance in accordance with the provisions of the proposed Bill. Paralegals are
restricted from charging fees from any aided person and to engage on activity reserved for advocates.

Part V of the Bill provides for persons who may apply for legal aid, general principles of legal aid, legal aid in civil proceedings and criminal proceedings by order of the Court. Further, it provides for legal aid to children and persons in police stations, prison and any other lawfully custody.
Part VI of the Bill deals with financial provisions. It contains provisions relating to sources of funds of the Board, annual estimates, an annual performance report and books of accounts.

Part VII of the Bill provides for Miscellaneous provisions, power of the Registrar to issue notice to require proof of existence of legal aid providers, obligation relating to professional conduct of legal aid providers, powers of the Minister to make regulations and code of conduct for legal aid providers and paralegals. Further, the Part provides for the repeal, savings and transitional arrangements. Dar es Salaam, HARRISON G. MWAKYEMBE 2nd August, 2016 Minister for Constitutional and
